statement: The discrete L structure is the filtered colimit of invariant hyperbolic peripheral structures on normal finite-index subgroups; transition maps are injective. PiL is not independently defined in the supplied body.

notes: The damaged exceptional-type list is explicitly repaired to 2g-2+n>0; original scans 179-182 are absent. Orientation is a line without chosen generator; + fixes a generator.

statement: Germ-only LT axioms do not determine a defining subgroup up to commensurability: the two closed surface factors in P_2,0 x P_2,0 are a counterexample, also profinitely.
notes: Closed genus-two factors have empty peripheral lists and trivial intersection. The literal existence axiom is refuted; the corrected definition includes the class as datum.

statement: Every discrete hyperbolic L-group is the orbifold path extension of a finite, possibly ineffective and orientation-reversing, surface action.
notes: Full reduction to Nielsen realization includes an explicit center-free pullback construction and equality of extension classes; no splitting is assumed.

statement: The centralizer of the defining hyperbolic surface group is the finite ineffective kernel and is isomorphic to the kernel of the finite outer action. It vanishes exactly when all finite-index subgroup centralizers vanish.
notes: All finite-index subgroups, not merely the center. P_2,0 x S3 shows center-freeness alone insufficient.

statement: Every finite extension of Z or Z^2 with specified linear action has an affine realization; the faithful-action centralizer criterion fails for torus translations.
notes: Exceptional nonhyperbolic types are not silently included in A.3/A.4. Averaging solves the real-valued extension cocycle.

statement: Marked realizations are Aut_L torsors and outer-marked realizations are Out_L torsors; conformal realizations are orbit spaces. Three signatures are computed.
notes: Examples (0;2,3;1), (0;2,4;1), and once-punctured torus, including the C4-fixed marked parameter i. Markings and unmarked conformal moduli are distinguished.

statement: C2*C4, with one cusp, refutes the proposed characterization of PSL2(Z) by trivial oriented outer L-group and trivial centralizers of every finite-index subgroup.
notes: Index-four kernel in C2*C4 is the once-punctured-torus group; finite action group C4 is within the requested bound.

statement: For C2*C3 with its cusp structure, Out_L^+=1, Out_L=C2, and Aut_L=PGL2(Z); its six epimorphisms to S3 form one conjugation orbit and have characteristic kernel F2.
notes: All six finite pairs and their S3 conjugacy orbit are enumerated, not sampled.

statement: For P hyperbolic and A finite abelian, Out_L(P x A)=Hom(P^ab,A) semidirect (Out_L(P) x Aut(A)); ineffective groups retain gerbe automorphisms absent from the effective coarse orbifold.
notes: Explicit product-gerbe theorem, including the (C2)^4 gauge subgroup for a genus-two surface. No replacement by a coarse space.

statement: Exact finite enumeration: all 24 groups of order <=12, all 42 admissible faithful closed genus-two group/signature rows, 17 realizable rows, 126 ineffective rows; 4368 small signatures, 4258 hyperbolic and 66 bad.

notes: Existence of generating vectors is exhaustive in the stated boxes; Hurwitz/Nielsen orbits are not counted. Genus<=2 with unbounded punctures is an infinite request. Orientation-reversing enumeration is not performed; realization theorem includes it.

statement: A finite extension of a specified profinite surface completion is the completion of its discrete finite-action extension when its outer action lifts to the discrete peripheral outer group; this factorization is necessary for a realization preserving that discretization.
manuscript_passages: C4 §52.2, folio 744, scan 193; comparison requested with LM3 B.8-B.11
notes: Center-freeness is independently proved from faithful regular-quotient actions on finite-cover homology. LM3 is not used as proof authority.

statement: Unrestricted profinite finite-action realization is not established: an arbitrary finite peripheral outer action must be shown to preserve a discrete surface lattice up to conjugacy, or a counterexample must be found.
notes: Audit-unresolved, not a literature-wide openness claim. A.16-A.18 prove geometric-closure cases and necessary tests. A.19-A.21 isolate the pure tripod C2 test as a nontrivial coherent solution of (A--I), invisible in every pro-prime quotient and in the universal S3 quotient. A.22 solves these equations on the entire free profinite metabelian quotient and detects its noninner action on a preserved quotient of order75. Supplements A.23-A.24 supply compatible lifts through class4 of the open pro5 quotient of the index-three kernel and preserve the complete earlier parameter spaces. The integral class5 problem and the remaining profinite quotients still require a lift or finite obstruction. No full profinite counterexample is claimed. Mixed finite multipliers and conjugacy of multiplier-minus-one involutions also remain; LM4 not supplied.

statement: The profinite L definition uses invariant completed loop structures on normal open subgroups, rank-one Zhat orientation modules and continuous germs; peripheral recovery makes transition maps injective. LT additionally retains a defining commensurability class.
notes: Primary Proposition 3.6 was opened and checked, including the algebraically-simple hypothesis; only integer nonzero powers needed for open germs.

statement: The finite ineffective-kernel centralizer criterion and Aut/Out marking torsor assertions remain valid for profinite hyperbolic L extensions.
notes: Independent proof that centralizers of open subgroups of the geometric completion vanish. No unproved profinite unique-roots assertion is used.

statement: Out_L,cts of the completed modular orbifold group surjects onto Zhat units by its rational arithmetic action, so the discrete conclusion Out_L=C2 does not extend literally.
notes: Uses the arithmetic action on [(P1-{0,1,infinity})/S3] and local Kummer inertia; no faithfulness theorem for the whole Galois action is needed. Finite-subgroup question remains A.12.

statement: The mixed-prime involution x->x^lambda,y->y of Fhat2, lambda_2=-1 and lambda_odd=1, has a semidirect extension that is not the completion of any finitely generated discrete group. It fails both standard peripheral structures, so is not an A.12 counterexample.

notes: Explicit independent proof by prime-dependent free rank of abelianization. Exhaustive 48-element metabelian quotient certifies failure of the standard torus commutator condition; tripod exclusion survives all profinite markings. Not claimed to exclude every possible torus peripheral structure. Each pro-prime action separately geometric.

statement: Every finite subgroup of the geometric closure for S_1,1 is conjugate to a discrete subgroup and realizable; its effective image has one of nine abstract types. The same holds for finite solvable subgroups of orientation-preserving geometric closures for every hyperbolic surface of genus<=2.
notes: Asada outer congruence form verified in Bux-Ershov-Rapinchuk Main Theorem. Zalesskii-Melnikov Theorem3.10 hypotheses A/B explicitly checked. Exact 10 and16 subgroup enumerations of D8,D12, not conjugacy counts. Boggi2026 Theorem5.1(i) used only for finite solvable subgroups and orientation-preserving mappings.

statement: Geometric realization forces global orientation signs and integral homology characters. Tripod realization would imply every finite subgroup of GT is trivial or C2 and multiplier-one torsion is absent. The checked recent theorems concern mapping class completions or pro-p groups and do not establish full peripheral realization.
notes: Necessary conditions and logical implication proved, not claimed sufficient. GT injectivity into pure peripheral Out proved using normalizers. Source audit separates torsion in mapping class completions from torsion inside GT. Schneps1997 question cited historically, not as current openness certification.

statement: Pure tripod outer automorphisms have a canonical group-section lift x->x^u,y->f^-1 y^u f with f in F'. Exact finite order is equivalent to the cyclotomic and nonabelian norm equations. For multiplier-one torsion the third conjugator is also in F', and both conjugators vanish in every free pro-prime quotient.

The pro-prime torsion argument is proved directly in integral Magnus series; it concerns actual normalized automorphisms, avoiding a torsion inference from a quotient by inner automorphisms.

statement: Simultaneous powering x->x^u,y->y^u preserves the full profinite tripod exactly for the two diagonal signs. The mixed sign (-1 at2,+1 elsewhere) passes every nilpotent powered-product test but fails in D24; all250 SmallGroups groups through48 and all293009 ordered pairs prove24 is the minimum finite witness order for this specified substitution.

notes: The full profinite automorphism exists for every unit by free substitution. Nilpotent testing means the powered-product conjugacy condition; no claim says it descends to every arbitrary finite quotient as an automorphism. The exhaustive minimum24 is for f=1 and the fixed mixed unit. No genuinely peripheral counterexample is claimed.

statement: The pure multiplier-one involution problem is exactly the finite inverse-limit system (A--I), with a fixed nonidentity residue. Every solution is trivial in the universal S3 quotient of order972. Exhaustive27 derived conjugator tests give norm2, third derived-conjugator9, and only identity jointly; independent Python confirms.

statement: The full free profinite metabelian quotient has a noninner continuous order-two pure peripheral automorphism with multiplier one. A continuous Alexander-ring idempotent constructs exact norm and third-conjugator solutions, invisible in every pro-prime and S3 quotient but noninner on a preserved quotient F25-additive semidirect C3 of order75. A lift to the full free profinite group is not established.

notes: Chen-Deligne Proposition3.2.1 and Corollary4.1.5 justify the actual completed Alexander module, without assuming a split extension. Compatible normalized Haar idempotents give the summand Z5[zeta3][[s1,s2]]; all divisions occur inside it. Outerness is certified by the order75 quotient, whose inner actions on F25 are powers of zeta3, not minus one. Exact code exhausts421875 associativity triples,5625 automorphism pairs,75 potential inner conjugators, and15 declared finite Haar cases. Infinite continuity and all norm equations are proved independently of finite testing. This is a metabelian approximation, not an A.12 counterexample.
